en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a panoramic view of a town at the foot of a steep, rocky mountain. The settlement has compact 2‑3 storey buildings with pitched roofs, streets and a bridge or road in the foreground. Printed captions at the bottom read "Piatra N." on the left and "Muntele Petricia" on the right. The right margin of the card is filled with handwritten text in a cursive script.
